summary.headline: Monthly quality updates continue without a quality update policy
summary.summary: Devices without a Windows quality updates policy continue receiving monthly quality updates through Windows Update; update rings and Windows Update client policies still control deferrals, deadlines, restarts, and notifications.
summary.adminImpact: Create a quality update policy only when a targeted deployment scenario is needed; retain update rings for ordinary servicing behavior.

summary.headline: Hotpatch report guidance is colocated with Hotpatch management
summary.summary: The Hotpatch guidance gains a Hotpatch quality updates report section for monitoring deployment status and errors.
summary.adminImpact: Use the Hotpatch quality updates report to monitor enabled policies and investigate deployment failures.

summary.headline: Hotpatch report content moves to the Hotpatch guidance
summary.summary: The quality update reports guidance no longer contains the additional Hotpatch report section.
summary.adminImpact: Use the Hotpatch guidance rather than the general quality update reports page for Hotpatch status and errors.

summary.headline: Quality update overview separates Hotpatch reporting content
summary.summary: A separator is removed as Hotpatch reporting guidance is moved into dedicated Hotpatch content.
summary.adminImpact: No quality update policy behavior changes.

summary.headline: Dedicated expedited quality update guidance is named explicitly
summary.summary: The dedicated article is titled Expedite Windows quality updates instead of Windows quality updates policy.
summary.adminImpact: Use this article when configuring an urgent quality update deployment.
